values.meaning: shield strength as percent of maximum health
values.quote: shield equal to {{as|10% of his '''maximum''' health}}

mechanics.claim: The shield lasts until broken and replenishes to full after a period without taking damage.
mechanics.quote: The shield lasts until it is broken, and replenishes to full strength after a few seconds of not taking damage.

mechanics.claim: Damage mitigated by shields does not refresh the passive's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: ''Granite Shield'' does not refresh its cooldown from damage that is mitigated by {{tip|shield|shields}}.
